meta.title: Tlapalli · Mexican folk art in San Miguel de Allende
meta.description: Folk art shop and workshop in downtown San Miguel de Allende: tin, brass, ceramics, clay, textiles and hand-blown glass. Workshops for visitors and shipping to the US and Canada.

story.title: Thirty years bringing hands together
story.lead: Tlapalli means “color” in Nahuatl. It began as a single table in the Jardín Principal; today it is an old house where more than forty artisan families from Guanajuato sell their work.
story.t1.title: The first table
story.t1.text: Aurelia Ramírez sells her father’s tin stars in front of the Parroquia.
story.t2.title: The house on Aldama
story.t2.text: We open the shop and welcome ceramists from Dolores Hidalgo and weavers from Coroneo.
story.t3.title: An open workshop
story.t3.text: Her granddaughters run workshops so anyone can take home something made with their own hands.
